# Game Idea: Canvas Runner

A simple endless runner implemented on an HTML canvas. The player controls a character that automatically moves forward across a scrolling landscape. Random obstacles such as spikes, gaps, and low-hanging barriers appear. The player can tap/click to **jump** or **slide** to avoid them.

**Lose condition:** The game ends when the character collides with an obstacle or falls into a gap.

**Goal:** Survive as long as possible; the score is the distance traveled.

1: // Enhanced endless runner with richer graphics
2: (() => {
3:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
4:   if (!canvas) return;
5:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
6:   const W = canvas.width = canvas.offsetWidth || 800;
7:   const H = canvas.height = canvas.offsetHeight || 200;
8: 
9:   // player definition
10:   const player = {
11:     x: 50,
12:     y: H - 30,
13:     w: 20,
14:     h: 30,
15:     vy: 0,
16:     jumpStrength: -8,
17:     gravity: 0.4,
18:     onGround: true,
19:     sliding: false,
20:     slideHeight: 15,
21:   };
22: 
23:   const obstacles = [];
24:   let speed = 2;
25:   let frame = 0;
26:   let score = 0;
27:   let gameOver = false;
28: 
29:   // Audio setup
30:   const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
31:   const playTone = (freq, duration = 0.1) => {
32:     const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
33:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
34:     osc.type = 'sine';
35:     osc.frequency.value = freq;
36:     osc.connect(gain);
37:     gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
38:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime);
39:     gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.2, audioCtx.currentTime + 0.01);
40:     gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
41:     osc.start();
42:     osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
43:   };
44:   const playJumpSound = () => playTone(440);
45:   const playSlideSound = () => playTone(220);
46:   const playHitSound = () => playTone(100);
47: 
48:   // Input handling
49:   const onJump = () => {
50:     if (player.onGround && !player.sliding) {
51:       player.vy = player.jumpStrength;
52:       player.onGround = false;
53:       playJumpSound();
54:     }
55:   };
56:     if (player.onGround && !player.sliding) {
57:       player.vy = player.jumpStrength;
58:       player.onGround = false;
59:     }
60:   };
61:   const onSlide = (down) => {
62:     if (down && player.onGround && !player.sliding) {
63:       player.sliding = true;
64:       player.h = player.slideHeight;
65:       player.y = H - player.h;
66:       playSlideSound();
67:     } else if (!down && player.sliding) {
68:       player.sliding = false;
69:       player.h = 30;
70:       player.y = H - player.h;
71:     }
72:   };
73:   document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
74:     if (e.code === 'Space' || e.code === 'ArrowUp') onJump();
75:     if (e.code === 'ArrowDown') onSlide(true);
76:   });
77:   document.addEventListener('keyup', (e) => {
78:     if (e.code === 'ArrowDown') onSlide(false);
79:   });
80:   canvas.addEventListener('click', onJump);
81: 
82:   // obstacle generator
83:   function addObstacle() {
84:     const type = Math.random() < 0.5 ? 'spike' : 'gap';
85:     const w = 20 + Math.random() * 30;
86:     const h = type === 'spike' ? 20 + Math.random() * 20 : 0; // gap handled by y=H
87:     const ob = {
88:       x: W,
89:       y: H - h,
90:       w,
91:       h,
92:       type,
93:     };
94:     obstacles.push(ob);
95:   }
96: 
97:   function update() {
98:     if (gameOver) return;
99: 
100:     // player physics
101:     player.vy += player.gravity;
102:     player.y += player.vy;
103:     if (player.y + player.h >= H) {
104:       player.y = H - player.h;
105:       player.vy = 0;
106:       player.onGround = true;
107:     }
108: 
109:     // obstacles movement
110:     for (let i = obstacles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
111:       const o = obstacles[i];
112:       o.x -= speed;
113:       // remove off-screen
114:       if (o.x + o.w < 0) obstacles.splice(i, 1);
115:     }
116:     // spawn
117:     if (frame % 100 === 0) addObstacle();
118: 
119:     // collision detection (AABB)
120:     for (const o of obstacles) {
121:       if (o.type === 'gap') continue; // gap handled by falling
122:       if (
123:         player.x < o.x + o.w &&
124:         player.x + player.w > o.x &&
125:         player.y < o.y + o.h &&
126:         player.y + player.h > o.y
127:       ) {
128:         playHitSound();
129:         gameOver = true;
130:       }
131:     }
132:     // gap check (if player is over a gap area)
133:     for (const o of obstacles) {
134:       if (o.type !== 'gap') continue;
135:       if (player.x + player.w > o.x && player.x < o.x + o.w) {
136:         // player is over gap
137:         if (player.y + player.h >= H) {
138:           gameOver = true;
139:         }
140:       }
141:     }
142: 
143:     score++;
144:     frame++;
145:     if (frame % 500 === 0) speed += 0.5; // gradual speed increase
146:   }
147: 
148:   function draw() {
149:     // sky gradient
150:     const skyGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
151:     skyGrad.addColorStop(0, '#87ceeb'); // light blue top
152:     skyGrad.addColorStop(1, '#b0e0e6'); // pale cyan bottom
153:     ctx.fillStyle = skyGrad;
154:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
155: 
156:     // ground with parallax layers
157:     const groundY = H - 30;
158:     ctx.fillStyle = '#555';
159:     ctx.fillRect(0, groundY, W, 30);
160:     ctx.fillStyle = '#777';
161:     ctx.fillRect(0, groundY + 5, W, 5);
162:     ctx.fillStyle = '#999';
163:     ctx.fillRect(0, groundY + 10, W, 3);
164: 
165:     // player with rounded rectangle and gradient
166:     const pGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(player.x, player.y, player.x, player.y + player.h);
167:     pGrad.addColorStop(0, '#4a90e2');
168:     pGrad.addColorStop(1, '#003399');
169:     ctx.fillStyle = pGrad;
170:     ctx.beginPath();
171:     ctx.roundRect(player.x, player.y, player.w, player.h, 4);
172:     ctx.fill();
173: 
174:     // obstacles
175:     for (const o of obstacles) {
176:       if (o.type === 'gap') continue;
177:       if (o.type === 'spike') {
178:         // draw triangle spike
179:         ctx.fillStyle = '#a52a2a';
180:         ctx.beginPath();
181:         ctx.moveTo(o.x, o.y + o.h);
182:         ctx.lineTo(o.x + o.w / 2, o.y);
183:         ctx.lineTo(o.x + o.w, o.y + o.h);
184:         ctx.closePath();
185:         ctx.fill();
186:       } else {
187:         ctx.fillStyle = '#f00';
188:         ctx.fillRect(o.x, o.y, o.w, o.h);
189:       }
190:     }
191: 
192:     // score
193:     ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
194:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
195:     ctx.fillText('Score: ' + Math.floor(score / 60), 10, 20);
196: 
197:     if (gameOver) {
198:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';
199:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
200:       ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
201:       ctx.font = '24px sans-serif';
202:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', W / 2 - 60, H / 2);
203:     }
204:   }
205: 
206:   function loop() {
207:     update();
208:     draw();
209:     if (!gameOver) requestAnimationFrame(loop);
210:   }
211: 
212:   loop();
213: })();

(End of file - total 213 lines)
</content>
